shortDescription: Home route that supports the dashboard home feed and user profile overview views.
fullDescription: Implements one reusable home-route view switcher contract that supports the dashboard-home-feed and user-profile-overview screens in their default states through view, state, activeTab, and selectedYear arguments. The dashboard view renders a dark developer home feed with a shared header, search, activity rail, repository feed cards, and side panels, while the profile view renders a GitHub-style header, profile navigation tabs, repository cards, and a contribution heatmap with interactive year selection.
